pub638.title: Publication 638: District Highway Safety Program Guide

hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.page: p. 8 (PDF p. 10), Comprehensive Loss Due to Reportable Traffic Crashes, Average Cost by max severity
rules: one cost per crash by its maximum severity (the book: 'Cost is now based on max crash severity'), every location type

Pub 638 (2024) Table 4-3, p. 4-9, prices 'Possible Injury and Unknown Severity' together at the C cost, and the 2025 book's possible-injury count includes PennDOT's unknown-severity and unknown-if-injured crashes; CrashIQ's core leaves U unpriced until shared-fixes.md item 1 lands
Pub 638 §4.8 (p. 4-8): costs are updated each year in the Crash Facts book; use the most current edition

statewide_rates.missing: Pub 638 §5.2.3 (p. 5-12): statewide average rates for State facilities are kept by PennDOT HSTOD (CDART Homogeneous Report) and given on request; no published table, and CrashIQ has no Pennsylvania traffic counts

screening.state_method: Potential for Safety Improvement / excess yearly crash cost from PA regionalized SPFs and Empirical Bayes (Pub 638, 2024, §5.2.2, pp. 5-9 to 5-10); PennDOT allows crash rates only at the District's direction (§5.2.3, p. 5-11)

spf_calibration.missing: Pub 638A (2021) gives district calibration factors for PA regionalized SPFs; not loaded (CrashIQ has no SPF engine)
